name: Felicity The Cat In The Sack
summary: Bluff auction game where players bid mice to win a sack of hidden cat cards with positive and negative values.
rules_text: Each player has 10 cards (cats -8,-5,3,5,8,11,15, rabbit 0, large and small dog) and 15 mice money; one random card is discarded from each hand unseen. 9 rounds: each player places one hand card face down in a row forming the sack. Cards are revealed left to right during the auction. Start player bids mice ( >0 ) or passes; bidding proceeds clockwise, must raise to continue. When a player passes, he takes back his bids and collects the mice on the lowest mouse card still available (2,3,4,6) and is out for the round, then next sack card is revealed. Last remaining player pays his bid to the bank and takes the sack. If exactly one dog is in the final row, it removes a cat: large dog removes highest positive cat (or lowest negative if no positive), small dog removes most negative cat (or lowest positive if none). Dogs then discarded. Winner becomes start player. Next round refill mouse cards from bank if possible. After 9 rounds score won cats plus remaining mice money; rabbit 0, dogs 0. Most points wins, tie broken by cat points.
rating_reason: Bluff bag with cats dogs hidden info turn-based
